run_streaming_nvdec_decoding: run the streaming NVDEC video decoding example with GPU acceleration on an input video file
decode_video_frames: decode video frames in streaming fashion using NVDEC GPU decoder with optional resizing and profiling
parse_args_cli: parse command line arguments for the streaming NVDEC decoding CLI including input file and device options
torch_cuda_warmup: initialize the CUDA context and perform a dry-run to warm up the GPU before decoding
run_benchmark: run the video decoding benchmark three times with CUDA warmup and optional profiling enabled
